articles.title: New research finds AI adoption is associated with more managers—and different managerial skills

articles.title: Invasive plants show limited spread in Andalusia's mountains
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: A study by the University of Córdoba (UCO) departments of Forest Engineering and of Botany, Ecology and Plant Physiology reveals that the presence of invasive plants in Sierra Nevada and the Sierra de los Filabres—two mountain ecosystems in Andalusia that are especially vulnerable to climate change and home to unique plant species—is currently low. Specifically, invasive plants are most common in the areas closest to the edges of roads, and their presence declines at the highest points of the mountains.
